---
title: "FACu fluctuation assay: noFLC vs FLC16 and FLC32 (rSalvador)"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(rsalvador)   # needs hypergeo for the *.plating functions
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Settings

```{r settings}
xlsx_file <- "TableS3_FACu_colonycounts.xlsx"   # in the same folder as this Rmd
sheet     <- "TableS3_counts"

# Approximate cells per culture at plating
Nt <- c(noFLC = 3e8, FLC16 = 2e8, FLC32 = 1e8)

cells_per_unselective_colony <- 1e3   # ~1e2 cells aimed for unselective vs ~1e5 selective
n_perm <- 999                         # permutations for analysis B
set.seed(1)

conds       <- c("noFLC", "FLC16", "FLC32")
comparisons <- list(c("noFLC", "FLC16"), c("noFLC", "FLC32"))
```

## Load data

Rows with no plating data for a condition are dropped. Selective counts that are plate medians (e.g. 5.5) are rounded half up, because rSalvador needs integers.

```{r data}
round_half_up <- function(x) floor(x + 0.5)

raw <- as.data.frame(read_excel(xlsx_file, sheet = sheet))
raw <- raw[!is.na(raw$Batch) & !grepl("^Events", raw$Batch), ]

get_cond <- function(cond, Nt) {
  d <- data.frame(batch = raw$Batch,
                  unsel = raw[[paste0(cond, "_unselective")]],
                  sel   = raw[[paste0(cond, "_selective")]])
  d <- d[!is.na(d$unsel) & !is.na(d$sel), ]
  d$cond   <- cond
  d$mc     <- round_half_up(d$sel)                      # integer mutant colonies
  d$plated <- d$unsel * cells_per_unselective_colony    # est. cells plated on selective
  d$norm   <- round_half_up(d$sel / d$unsel * 100)      # per-1e5 value, rounded
  d$e      <- d$plated / Nt[[cond]]                     # fraction of culture plated
  d
}
dat <- lapply(setNames(conds, conds), get_cond, Nt = Nt)
sapply(dat, nrow)   # cultures per condition

all_dat <- do.call(rbind, dat)
all_dat$cond <- factor(all_dat$cond, levels = conds)
ggplot(all_dat, aes(cond, sel / unsel * 100)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0, size = 2) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, colour = "red") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mutants per 1e5 cells plated") + theme_bw()
```


Partial-plating model

`newton.LD.plating(mc, e)` takes one plated fraction per call, so each condition uses the mean of its per-culture `e`. The conditions are compared with a permutation test on the mutation rate (m / Nt): cultures are shuffled between the two conditions, keeping each culture's own Nt, and the log ratio of rates is recomputed.

```{r analysisB}
fit_m <- function(d) {
  if (exists("est_m")) return(est_m(d$mc, mean(d$e)))   # test hook, ignore
  newton.LD.plating(d$mc, mean(d$e))
}

fitB <- data.frame(condition = conds,
                   Nt = Nt[conds],
                   mean_e = sapply(dat, function(d) mean(d$e)),
                   m = sapply(dat, fit_m))
fitB$mu <- fitB$m / fitB$Nt
fitB

perm_test <- function(d0, d1, B) {
  stat <- function(a, b) log(fit_m(b) / Nt[[b$cond[1]]]) - log(fit_m(a) / Nt[[a$cond[1]]])
  obs  <- stat(d0, d1)
  pool <- rbind(d0, d1); n0 <- nrow(d0)
  null <- replicate(B, {
    idx <- sample(nrow(pool))
    a <- pool[idx[1:n0], ];  b <- pool[idx[-(1:n0)], ]
    a$cond <- d0$cond[1];    b$cond <- d1$cond[1]
    stat(a, b)
  })
  c(fold_change = exp(obs), p_value = (1 + sum(abs(null) >= abs(obs), na.rm = TRUE)) / (1 + B))
}

resB <- do.call(rbind, lapply(comparisons, function(p) {
  r <- perm_test(dat[[p[1]]], dat[[p[2]]], n_perm)
  data.frame(comparison = paste(p, collapse = " vs "), fold_change_in_mu = unname(r[1]), perm_p = unname(r[2]))
}))
resB
```


## Notes

- Rounding of plate medians, the noisy unselective counts (about 25-200 colonies), and using a mean `e` per condition all add error.
